events.title: Steam Next Fest: roll dice, build an army
events.summary: Of Dice and Minions is a roguelite auto battler where you roll five dice to build an army, then watch it fight on its own. Each die is a minion type, and the number tells you how many show up. Hold the dice you want, reroll the rest for a poker hand, then hit COMMIT. Steam Next Fest is on We're part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. If you're just finding the game, welcome. The free demo is ready to play. events.title: Roll, hold, commit: the Of Dice and Minions demo is out now
events.summary: The demo is out now Of Dice and Minions is an auto-battler where you roll dice to build your army. Each of your five dice is a minion type. The higher you roll, the more of that minion spawn. Roll, hold and reroll to land a poker hand: the hand decides which dice deploy and what bonus they get. Then your minions fight on their own. events.title: Meet Of Dice and Minions: roll dice, build an army (demo on the way)
events.summary: Hi, I'm Rob, the solo developer at Foorbytes. If you just found this page, welcome! Here's the quick version of what Of Dice and Minions is. Roll the dice. Build an army. Every battle starts with five dice. Hold the ones you like and reroll the rest, like Yahtzee. The poker hand you land decides your army: a pair brings a small squad, a full house brings a whole army, and five of a kind brings... you'll see. Then they fight on their own Your minions battle automatically: knights, archers, mages
